name: Milly's Harvest
summary: In the Northshire Vineyards, Milly's Harvest lies abandoned after the Defias arrive. Crates and buckets of grapes risk theft or being crushed beneath the abbey guards' boots.

sections.title: A Fragile Yield
sections.body: Milly Osworth gathers grapes in the Northshire Vineyards. The harvest matters to local vintners and the abbey community. When armed brigands in red masks enter the fields, Milly flees to the abbey grounds. Her fresh-picked grapes lie scattered between the rows.

sections.title: Collateral Damage
sections.body: Stormwind guards watch the valley entrance, but their small numbers leave Northshire vulnerable. The garrison promises to drive out the Defias. Milly fears a long fight between guards and thieves will ruin her harvest. The crates may be trampled or carried off as provisions, costing Northshire one of its few peaceful harvests.

faq.answer: Milly's Harvest is the grapes Milly Osworth picked and packed into crates and buckets before Defias thugs seized the Northshire Vineyards.

faq.q: Why were the crates left behind in the vineyard?
aliases: why did milly leave the grapes
faq.answer: Defias bandits raided the vineyards while Milly was harvesting. She had to leave the grapes behind and flee to Northshire Abbey.

faq.q: Why couldn't the Northshire guards retrieve the harvest?
faq.answer: Northshire's guards are stretched thin by Defias incursions and local threats. Milly also fears their boots could crush the grapes as they drive off the bandits.

faq.q: Who are the bandits threatening the harvest?
faq.answer: The bandits threatening the harvest belong to the Defias Brotherhood, a ring of outlaws and brigands causing unrest throughout Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: The threat to Northshire's farmers shows how thin Stormwind's garrison has become. Everyday people rely on passing adventurers to protect their livelihoods.
As a human starting in Northshire, you may first meet the Defias Brotherhood's lawlessness on your own doorstep when you recover Milly's grapes.
